title: Informed Consent
description: The user may not be fully aware of what data is being collected by the wearable device, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Linkability
description: Sensor telemetry data (e.g., heart rate, GPS position) can be linked to the user, potentially allowing for tracking and profiling.

title: Data Retention
description: The wearable device may store sensitive telemetry data for longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access.

title: Data Disclosure
description: If the wearable device is compromised, sensitive user data could be disclosed to unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The wearable device may unintentionally share sensitive data (e.g., GPS traces, exercise sessions) with unauthorized parties due to misconfigurations or vulnerabilities in the device's software.

title: Data Interception
description: Data transmitted from the wearable device to the companion app may be intercepted by malicious actors during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The companion app may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: User Misunderstanding of Data Usage
description: Users may not fully understand how their data is being used by the companion app, leading to potential misuse of their personal information without informed consent.

title: Inadequate User Consent
description: The user may not fully understand what data is being collected and how it will be used, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Leakage through App Vulnerabilities
description: The companion app may have vulnerabilities that could be exploited, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive user data.

title: Improper Data Storage Practices
description: The app may store user data insecurely, making it susceptible to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Metadata Exposure
description: Data in transit may expose metadata that can be used to infer user behavior or identity.

title: Unauthorized Access to Health Logs
description: The companion mobile app may inadvertently share health logs with unauthorized users due to improper access controls or vulnerabilities in the app.

title: Data Breach of Health Logs
description: The health log store may be susceptible to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive health information stored within.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Health logs being transmitted from the app to the health log store may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The mobile app may inadvertently share GPS location data with unauthorized parties due to insufficient access controls or vulnerabilities in the app.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: GPS location data may be intercepted during transmission to the location history store, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Inadequate Data Retention Policies
description: The location history store may retain GPS data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse of the data.

title: User Unawareness of Data Usage
description: Users may not be adequately informed about how their location data is being used or shared, leading to a lack of consent and potential privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The health log store may inadvertently share sensitive health data with unauthorized parties during the data transfer process.

title: Inadequate Data Anonymization
description: The analytics service may not adequately anonymize the data, leading to potential identification of individuals through the analysis of calorie, weight, and exercise logs.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Sensitive health data may be intercepted during transmission from the health log store to the analytics service, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The location history data may be shared without proper consent from the user, leading to unauthorized access to personal movement patterns.

title: Inaccurate Data Interpretation
description: The analytics service may misinterpret the location data, leading to incorrect conclusions about the user's health or behavior, which could affect the user's privacy and trust.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The health analytics service may retain location history data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of sensitive information.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: During the transmission of location history data, there is a risk of interception by unauthorized parties, leading to potential privacy breaches.

title: Inferred Insights Leakage
description: The health analytics service may inadvertently share sensitive inferred insights about users' health conditions, leading to unauthorized access to personal health information.

title: Data Misuse by App
description: The companion mobile app may misuse the received health insights, either by sharing them with third parties without user consent or by using them for purposes other than intended.

title: Data in Transit Exposure
description: During the transmission of health insights from the analytics service to the mobile app, there is a risk of interception by unauthorized parties, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Informed Consent Issues
description: The app may not adequately inform users about the data being collected and how it will be used, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Misuse
description: The user may misinterpret the trends and inferred condition indicators, leading to inappropriate self-diagnosis or treatment.

title: Data Leakage
description: Data in transit may be intercepted, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive health information.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The user may share their app data with third parties without understanding the implications, leading to unintended use of their health information.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The health analytics service may inadvertently share sensitive health data with the cloud hosting provider without proper consent from the data subjects.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Analytics data and health datasets may be intercepted during transmission to the cloud hosting provider, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Inadequate Data Protection Measures
description: The cloud hosting provider may not implement sufficient security measures to protect the stored health data, leading to potential breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The cloud hosting provider may retain health data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.
